BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

J. C. Squire, ed.  A Book of Women’s Verse.  1921.

By Amy Levy (1861–1889)

In September

T
HE SKY
 is silver-grey; the long
Slow waves caress the shore.
On such a day as this I have been glad,
Who shall be glad no more.
